    Args:
        intervals: Iterable of pairs [start, end] (or any two-item sequence).

    Returns:

    merged = []
    for start, end in normalized:
        if not merged or start > merged[-1][1]:
            merged.append([start, end])
        else:
            if end > merged[-1][1]:

    return merged

    else:

    edge_set = set()

            source, target = edge
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise ValueError("Each edge must be a (source, target) pair")
        if source not in nodes_set:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown source node: {source!r}")
        if target not in nodes_set:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown target node: {target!r}")
        if (source, target) in edge_set:
            continue
        edge_set.add((source, target))
        adj[source].add(target)
        indegree[target] += 1
    heap = [node for node in nodes_set if indegree[node] == 0]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    order = []
    while heap:
        node = heapq.heappop(heap)
        order.append(node)
        for nxt in adj[node]:
            indegree[nxt] -= 1
            if indegree[nxt] == 0:
                heapq.heappush(heap, nxt)
    if len(order) != len(nodes_set):
        raise ValueError("Cycle detected in edges")
    return order
